reviewScope: Layout-only browser correction pilot using unchanged materially held caregiver-innocent/v4 imagery. Root material HOLD remains. Not final scene/image release or catalogue-wide acceptance.

knownRisks: Root material HOLD: etched-looking wine filigree, patterned paper/cloth and overly amber finish. Browser PASS cannot clear this hold.
Opening scene crop/breathing is unchanged and has tight glass clearance; inspect it and the new bottom-left phone cue.
Phone caption now follows the full-bleed image in document flow; image intentionally scrolls away. Old persistent-background phone assertions must be adapted.

reviewRequirements: Use current actual TheReading/CSS with authored pour title, personality, tagline and reading. Existing fixture placeholders must not be used as authored-copy proof.
Record actual font identity and readiness; inspect writable paper excluding hole/string and actual ink, not only bounding boxes.
Check rest, reduced motion, arrival, breathing endpoints/intermediates and scrolling. Named/bare comparison captures use identical animation phase.
Inspect both original JPEGs and rendered full pages for recipe, materials, whole vessel/paper and two recognizable personality traces.
Record browser/console/resource failures; verify candidate not fallback.
Recheck request, image, pour and runtime fingerprints before completion. Changes make report stale; never modify immutable request.

For portrait phones, evaluate the sequential image/caption/reading flow, not the old persistent-image scrolling contract. Entire opening vessel/tag/trace cores stay visible during arrival, breathing and reduced motion; after deliberate scroll they may leave the viewport normally.

Inspect the new Your cocktail anchor (44px target) against paper, glass and essential traces in every opening phase; activate it and the caption recipe/reading cue. Confirm actual title scroll-margin clears navigation and no hidden/faded caption or disabled link.
Check early scroll and both anchor destinations for separation of scene, full authored caption and recipe; include320x568, long name,200% text zoom and enlarged text. Do not truncate or hide content.

Test all eight listed seed inks for both names on settled/reduced-motion portrait phones plus darkest relevant state. The existing private reviewer fixture hardcodes red; adapt it privately for seed testing and document the actual fixture fingerprints. Do not modify producer inputs.

Retain desktop/ultrawide regression coverage, opening/arrival/breathing handover and reduced motion. Add representative landscape-phone and print-emulation smoke checks: no new opening cue in desktop/print, no blank spacer in print.
Include long authored title/tagline spot checks with other ready representative pours in a private fixture; identify source hashes. Do not infer collection-wide acceptance from this one pour.
Do not report material acceptance for the held image. Local project checks may be run by the reviewer under its own approvals and reported separately; do not substitute them for browser evidence.
callback: Return batch ID, disposition, absolute report path and key findings to Robin/producer via the existing callback/shared-files route. No CLI resume against the active producer. PASS is this layout browser gate only; material hold remains.
